author: edwong57
body:
Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete the following terms:

- Ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31955
- Regulation of cargo loading into COPII-coated vesicle: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32110
- Vesicle cargo loading: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32112
- Exocyst localization: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31202
- Protein localization to phagophore assembly site: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32718

| Term | Ticket | EXP | Suggested target |
|---|---|---|---|
| GO:0070086 ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis | geneontology/go-ontology#31955 | 32 | GO:0072583 clathrin-dependent endocytosis / GO:0006897 endocytosis / GO:0001881 receptor recycling |
| GO:2000395, GO:2000396, GO:2000397 (positive) regulation of ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis | geneontology/go-ontology#31955 | 7 | GO:2000369 / GO:1900186 / GO:2000370 (regulation of clathrin-dependent endocytosis) |
| GO:1901301 regulation of cargo loading into COPII-coated vesicle | geneontology/go-ontology#32110 | 4 | GO:0060628 regulation of ER to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport |
| GO:1901303 negative regulation of cargo loading into COPII-coated vesicle | geneontology/go-ontology#32110 | 2 | GO:7770035 negative regulation of ER to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport |
| GO:0035459 vesicle cargo loading | geneontology/go-ontology#32112 | 4 | MF GO:0140312 cargo adaptor / GO:0038024 cargo receptor activity + transport process |
| GO:0090110 COPII-coated vesicle cargo loading | geneontology/go-ontology#32112 | 41 | GO:0090114 COPII-coated vesicle budding / GO:0006888 ER to Golgi v-m-t + MF GO:0038024 cargo receptor / GO:0140312 cargo adaptor activity |
| GO:0035652, GO:0035653, GO:0035654 clathrin-coated vesicle cargo loading (AP-1, AP-3) | geneontology/go-ontology#32112 | 7 | MF GO:0035615 clathrin-cargo adaptor activity + GO:0006895 / GO:0006896 |
| GO:0051601 exocyst localization | geneontology/go-ontology#31202 | 11 | GO:0006887 exocytosis / GO:0006893 Golgi to plasma membrane transport |
| GO:0060178 regulation of exocyst localization | geneontology/go-ontology#31202 | 12 | GO:0017157 regulation of exocytosis |
| GO:0034497 protein localization to phagophore assembly site | geneontology/go-ontology#32718 | 38 | GO:0000045 autophagosome assembly / GO:0016236 macroautophagy / GO:0032258 Cvt pathway |

Where the evidence only shows that a protein is located somewhere, or is a readout of a disrupted pathway, please consider a cellular component annotation or removing the annotation.

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed (158) are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LjkG2Xu_3scxPlEzKhUiUbJE4LHBrm4a8lMpQbgJkVM/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups (experimental annotations):

| Group | EXP |
|---|---|
| SGD | 74 |
| UniProt | 50 |
| MGI | 15 |
| FlyBase | 5 |
| TAIR | 4 |
| ComplexPortal | 3 |
| PomBase (DONE) | 3 |
| Alzheimers_University_of_Toronto - done | 2 |
| WB | 1 |
| ZFIN | 1 |


Thanks.
title: Review annotations to vesicle-mediated transport and protein localization terms proposed for obsoletion (geneontology/go-ontology#31955, #32110, #32112, #31202, #32718)
